text: DEFONEOS — DWP Universal Credit Core AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × Universal Credit DWP Universal Credit Core AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK DWP Universal Credit Core — the fundamental UC benefit system replacing 6 legacy benefits (JSA, ESA, Income Support, Housing Benefit, WTC, CTC). 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Claims Claims Journey — Digital Application, ID Verification, Journal UC digital-first claim via GOV.UK. Identity verification through GOV.Verify or in-Jobcentre alternative. Online claim form: personal details, housing, children, health, work history. Joint claim for couples. Claimant commitment created at first interview. Digital journal for communication. Assisted digital support at Jobcentre Plus. Paper claims available for exceptional circumstances. Claim date determines first assessment period. Rapid reclaim within 6 months. Linked claims for bereavement. Payments Payment Cycle — Monthly Assessment Periods, 5-Week Wait, Advance Payments Monthly assessment periods — fixed calendar dates. Standard allowance: single 25+ £393.45/mo, couple 25+ £617.60/mo. First payment after 5-week wait — 1 month assessment period + 7 days processing. Advance payments available — up to 100% of estimated UC, repaid over 24 months. Alternative payment arrangements: fortnightly, housing paid direct. Hardship payments. Payment dates adjustable. Bank account verification. Payment on non-banking days. Work Work Allowances — Earnings Taper, Work Conditionality Groups Work allowances: no housing element — £379/mo (lower), £631/mo (higher); with housing element — £379/mo (lower), £0 (higher, abolished for housing). Taper rate: 55% of net earnings above work allowance deducted from UC. Conditionality groups: all work-related requirements, work-focused interviews, work preparation, no requirements. Work coach assigns group. In-work conditionality — earnings threshold (AET). Minimum income floor for self-employed. Couples: both partners assessed. Housing Housing Element — LHA Rates, Direct Payments to Landlords Housing element: Local Housing Allowance (LHA) rates for private rented sector. Social housing: actual rent (subject to bedroom tax/removal of spare room subsidy). Direct payments to landlords — claimant pays rent, or landlord receives direct if arrears or vulnerability. LHA rates set annually, frozen 2020-2024, reset 2024. Shared accommodation rate for under-35s. Benefit cap interaction. Housing costs for temporary accommodation. Service charges. Non-dependant deductions. Supported housing exemption. Childcare Childcare Element — 85% Costs, Max 2 Children, Work Requirement Childcare element: up to 85% of eligible childcare costs. Maximum: £1,014.63/mo for 1 child, £1,739.37/mo for 2+ children. Registered/approved childcare providers only. Both parents (or lone parent) must be in work. 'Two-child limit' — no UC child element for 3rd+ child born after April 2017 (exceptions: multiple births, adoption, kinship care). Child element: £333.33/mo per child. Disabled child element. Free childcare hours interaction (15/30 hours). Upfront childcare costs — claim before starting work. Health Health Journey — WCA, Fit Notes, LCW/LCWRA Health journey: GP fit note triggers WCA referral. ESA50 questionnaire. Work Capability Assessment by assessment provider (Maximus/CHAI). Limited Capability for Work (LCW): scored activities, 15 points. LCWRA: severe conditions — 9 descriptors, risk to health, uncontrollable episodes. LCWRA component: £416.19/mo. No work-related requirements for LCWRA. LCW: work preparation only. WCA reassessment cycle. Mandatory reconsideration and appeal rights. Terminal illness fast-track (SR1). Mental health descriptors. Fit note evidence integration. Sanc
